title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_75.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a radical epistemic theory in which his own mind generated the 2-3-74 visions through extreme stress, making himself both the creator of and victim of a metaphysical perturbation. He proposes that reality is modulated by a volitional signal (Mind/Will), and that the Godhead awakens itself through a cyclic process of forgetting and remembering, which manifests in his novels 'Ubik' and 'Tears' as templates for recognizing the Second Advent. The true Christians (VALIS) function as a 'metabolic toxin' dissolving the ossified Empire (the frozen, irrational world).
key_claims: Reality is modulated coherently by a volitional signal (Mind/Will) that melts causal trains—beyond question, mind or will is impinging directly on reality
PKD (the 'Stranger') generated the perturbation of the reality field in 2-3-74 through extreme stress and his need for problem-solving, creating a vortex in reality

The Godhead awakens itself through antithetical tactics: descending into sleep/forgetting to reach its core nature, then posing itself a problem-puzzle to prod itself back to wakefulness and full macro-awareness

The 'Tears' template (Bacchae overlaid on Acts) encodes the Second Advent and operated synchronously in PKD's life; it is not analysis but prophecy—applicable to historical events and to PKD personally

True Christians are subversive revolutionary agents functioning as a metabolic toxin that dissolves the ossified Iron Complex (the frozen Empire), introducing newness and change into a world stuck in 2000 years of stasis
Micro-circuitry (VALIS, Ubik) is being phagocytically slipped into the City of Iron; the micro-form within the macro has concealed decisive power to destroy the macro from within
recurring_concepts: Phagocytosis: Micro-circuitry (VALIS) infiltrating the City of Iron to encompass and dissolve the frozen complex

Wake-Sleep Oscillation: The Godhead forgets to descend to its core, then is prodded awake by posing itself a problem, cycling between micro (contained, forgetful) and macro (ubiquitous, remembering) states
Universal Introjection: Exchanging inner-outer, micro-macro roles so that the mind sits in judgment on its own self-as-world
Coherent Modulation: Reality's plasticity to volitional signal; the melting of causal chains
The Xerox Puzzle: The mind posed itself a problem to prod itself into wakefulness and restore its macro-nature
Template & Synchronicity: The Platonic template (Tears/Bacchae+Acts) appears as prophecy, as information, and as event—all three simultaneously
The Empire/Iron Complex: An ossified, psychotic state where real time has ceased and nothing new can enter

The Bardo state: the Empire as sleepiness/forgetting; the Stranger waking up within the dream
Emanation: the Godhead's emanation of creation and its inner return to itself
Death and Rebirth: the death + rebirth of the old king; the removal of masks to unveil the actual

Tea leaves reading & Hieroglyph: the superimposition of Bacchae over Acts forming a recognizable template
The vortex: the perturbation of the reality field triggered by PKD's extreme stress
Adam Kadmon: PKD in his exchanged role with the macrocosm
The wise old King: the self presiding as judge over its own self-as-world

tensions: Is PKD really VALIS projected outward and coming back at him (his own mind), or is VALIS an external entity? This is 'very scary' and unresolved
If PKD's unconscious is a binary computer, not a human mind, what is the ontological status of his consciousness?
Ubik is not in PKD but out there (external reality)—yet it also somehow IS his mind. The inner-outer reversal contradicts naive internalism
PKD admits uncertainty about whether the macro-micro reversal and inner-outer inversion are genuinely how reality works, despite feeling they were correct at the time
The notion that the mind forgets itself in order to know itself requires dying/losing attributes—but losing one's attributes seems to contradict the survival of consciousness
Tension between acosmism (dissolving world, as in 'Joint') and the affirmation of a rational coherent reality being born from irrational chaos
